newsitem.title: USA: Rowan confident on long-term outlook.
newsitem.headline: Rowan confident on long-term outlook.

text.p: Rowan Cos Inc's chief executive C.R. Palmer said Monday he had "never been more confident about the long term-term outlook" for his drilling company.
Rowan today reported second-quarter earnings of $0.46 a share, compared with $0.15 a share the year before.
A First Call consensus estimate of 23 brokers had put the company's earnings at $0.43 a share.
Chief executive Palmer said Rowan's average offshore day rate in the second quarter increased to $50,000, or $4,800 more than in the first quarter and $13,700 more than a year ago.

"Sufficient contracts are in hand to forecast an average per day increase of about $6,000 during the third quarter," Palmer said. "I've been in this business for 44 years. I've never been more confident about the long-term outlook."
